thread.title: A VIP Peak Inside Jim Cramer's Members-Only Action Alerts Plus Call (Video)

author: Justin Ho
title: A VIP Peak Inside Jim Cramer's Members-Only Action Alerts Plus Call (Video)
text:
Jim Cramer's January Members-Only Call discussed markets, FAANG STOCKS and more Thursday, Jan.17. We hope you found the conversation valuable!
Have you ever wondered why Jim holds these calls? He talked about it Thursday. Cramer said, "We do these calls because as a former professional hedge fund manager I always thought that investors had a right to know what went on behind the scenes."
He added, "I think communication about what and how we think is at the utmost and the calls are the best place to do it. We are trying to teach you to be a better manager of your own money."
"We want to remind members that real portfolio management is at the heart of what club membership is about. At its core, our service teaches our subscribers what it means to run money, bringing you behind the scenes into not only the "what" of our day-to-day trading, but more importantly, also the "why" with analysis that supports our decisions, helping subscribers make sense of the immense amount of moving pieces day-to-day that help inform any investment decision."
FAANG stocks--Facebook ( FB ) , Amazon ( AMZN ) , Apple ( AAPL ) , Netflix and Google's parent company, Alphabet ( GOOG ) --were just a few of the stocks discussed Thursday.
